significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the conclusion that an "answer commitment point"—after which the residual stream "stably encodes the eventual final answer"—predicts that subsequent chain-of-thought can be removed without materially changing accuracy; this is a form-(iii) predictive coupling with a threshold, not merely an existence claim. It would constrain token-allocation decisions and interpretations of long post-commitment traces, a consequential issue given that budget forcing in Muennighoff et al.'s s1: Simple Test-Time Scaling (2025) shows that reasoning-token allocation can affect accuracy, although linear decodability supplies only a limited mechanism for why later computation is inert. The claim determinately establishes a behavioral phenomenon and internal marker, while refutation would rule out stable answer commitment as a general training-free stopping signal but not other internal completion signals. In the topic-substitution check, efficient mechanistic early stopping alone would not earn this score; the specific stability-to-safe-exit coupling and commitment-to-verbalization gap add some weight, but this remains close to the obvious first hypothesis for the assigned topic.

reach.justification: The named handle is a "cheap probe" used as a "training-free online early-exit controller," and it is ex ante because it detects stabilization during generation and leaves an action window to "terminate reasoning early and emit the answer." Although the probe may require per-setting re-extraction, the substantive conclusion predicts a transferable relation—stable committed-answer decoding should precede safe exit—whereas the particular direction, threshold, and claimed "25-45% token reduction" need not transfer. The asserted scope covers long-CoT reasoning across math and logic and would be usable by researchers and practitioners operating or shipping inference systems; the separate commitment-versus-verbalization gap is mainly a post-hoc faithfulness diagnostic. After substituting away the claim, the topic alone would not provide this particular online gating handle, so the score reflects lead time and practitioner uptake rather than the general importance of efficient reasoning.
